name: Churn Rate
test-only-meta-description: Churn rate is the share of users who stop using a product in a period.
test-only-body:
Churn rate is the share of users who stop using a product during a period.

How to Calculate Churn Rate

InputValue
Users at start10,000
Users lost500

Key Takeaways

  • Churn is users lost divided by users at the start of the period.

Related Terms

  • Retention rate
  • Active user
